subject: Intro + next steps: Redwood inference for Verdant Analytics
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@verdant-analytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + next steps: Redwood inference for Verdant Analytics

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re all aligned and can move this forward: 

What we heard from you:
- Primary use: customer-facing summarization and search for your insights product (latency target ~150ms P95)
- Current stack: in-house embedding index + hybrid cloud compute, budget for inference consolidation in 2027
- Key concerns: data residency, audit logs, and predictable unit economics

Recommended next steps:
1) Intro to your budget owner/economic buyer — you mentioned Priya Singh might be the right person. Can you confirm and loop her in?
2) Security questionnaire + SOC 2 evidence — Rishi will share the standard pack and a short summary of controls.
3) Technical deep-dive — Alex to run a 45-min latency/cost analysis session with your infra team (we can do a live perf test).

Attachments: redwood-pricing-overview.pdf (high-level pricing), mutual-action-plan-v1.xlsx (proposed timeline and owners).

If that looks right, could you either: 1) introduce me to Priya and her preferred procurement contact, or 2) tell me the preferred procurement process (SOW/PO/contracting timeline)?

Appreciate it — I’ll follow up with the security pack and a suggested calendar invite for the technical deep-dive.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

---
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform | https://www.redwood.com

From: Samir Rao <samir@verdant-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro + next steps: Redwood inference for Verdant Analytics

Thanks Marissa — great recap and much appreciated. Quick answers: 

- Priya Singh is indeed the budget owner for platform initiatives. I’ve copied her here.
- Procurement: we typically do an SOW + PO workflow. Procurement lead is Mira Patel (mira.patel@verdant-analytics.com). Typical cycle is 4–6 weeks for standard SaaS with small redlines.
- Timeline: we’re aiming to include inference consolidation in Q1 2027 budget; a vendor shortlist decision would be ideal by end of Nov 2026.

Priya / Mira — looping you in to Marissa and team from Redwood. They’ve shared a short pricing overview and a proposed MAP. Can we schedule a 20–30min intro next week to confirm scope and budget?

—Samir
Head of Product | Verdant Analytics

Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro + next steps: Redwood inference for Verdant Analytics

Hi all — thanks for the intro, Samir. 

Marissa — happy to meet. A few quick context items from my side: 
- Headcount + budget for platform consolidation sits with me for next FY.
- Key decision criteria: predictable unit cost, SLA for latency, SOC 2 compliance, and ease of migration from our current infra.
- Procurement handoff: I’ll work with Mira but I expect legal to ask for standard data processing addendum and our security team will request SOC 2 + any network controls.

I’m available next Wednesday 10–11am ET or Thursday 2–4pm ET for a 30-minute intro. Please send an invite and include any materials you want reviewed ahead of time.

Thanks,
Priya Singh
VP, Platform Operations | Verdant Analytics
priya.singh@verdant-analytics.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@verdant-analytics.com>, Samir Rao <samir@verdant-analytics.com>

Subject: Re: Intro + next steps: Redwood inference for Verdant Analytics

Thanks Priya — great to meet you (virtually). I’ve put a 30-min slot on Wed 2026-08-11 10:00am ET / 7:00am PT and included a short agenda:

Agenda (30m):
- 10m: Quick intros and scope (Samir/Priya)
- 10m: Rishi — security & SOC 2 summary, evidence we can share now
- 10m: Alex — infra/latency approach and perf testing plan

I’ve attached the pricing overview and MAP again and included the HubSpot deal link here for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/VERD-2026-07-01

Next steps for our side:
- Rishi to share SOC 2 pack and a short control summary before the meeting.
- Alex to prepare a short perf/runbook tailored to Verdant’s latency targets.
- Marissa to add notes & update the MAP after the meeting.

If that timing doesn’t work for anyone, please propose alternatives. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
